## Project Overview

Welcome to the **Environmental Compliance Agency (ECA)**. An auto manufacturer is claiming their new fleet of vehicles has an ultra-low carbon footprint. Your team's job is to audit their specifications using historical fleet data. We will ingest a dataset, visualize the distributions, overlay regulatory thresholds, and train a **Linear Regression** machine learning model to verify their emission claims.

*Data Attribution: This dataset and core regression concept originate from the [IBM Developer Skills Network / Cognitive Class](https://cognitiveclass.ai/) Machine Learning with Python curriculum.*
